渔人码头适合留半天慢慢走，不必把水族馆、游船、缆车和每家餐厅排成一串。编辑建议先: Give Fisherman’s Wharf half a day rather than stringing together every aquarium, cruise, cable car and restaurant. Start with an editorial allowance of 2–3 hours for sea lions and the waterfront, then add one paid attraction if you wish. Allow extra time for meals and lines. PIER 39 is one part of the waterfront, and it is not Pier 33, where Alcatraz ferries depart.
先看海狮，再决定今天花多少钱: See the sea lions before choosing paid activities
PIER 39 没有围起来收取统一门票，进入公共商业步行区、在开放观景处看 K-: PIER 39 has no general admission gate. You do not need a package ticket to walk its public shopping areas or watch K-Dock sea lions from an open viewing area. These are wild animals whose numbers change with season, food and migration. Aquariums, cruises, rides, shopping and meals have separate costs. Compare individual options rather than assuming a waterfront package is required.
路线为编辑建议，沿公开人行道向西走；累了可以在 Jefferson Street: This editorial route follows public sidewalks west. If tired, finish around Jefferson Street rather than repeating the full walk back.

先认出口和集合点，再到 K-Dock 对面的开放观景位置。: Identify an exit and meeting point, then use an open viewing spot facing K-Dock.
走过码头街景，想吃饭就先看完整菜单、价格和等位。: Enjoy the waterfront street scene and check full menus, prices and waiting times before choosing a meal.
在开放滨水空间坐一会儿，把海湾作为结束，不预设登历史船。: Rest in an open waterfront area and finish with the bay view, without assuming historic ships are available to board.
历史船舶这一步，旧攻略已经不适用: Old historic-ship itineraries need an update
截至本次核验，NPS 明确说明 Hyde Street Pier 因重建关闭，馆: At this check, NPS states that Hyde Street Pier is closed for reconstruction and its historic ships have temporarily moved to Mare Island in Vallejo. For a ship-focused visit, check the Maritime Park’s official location and opening details separately. Do not promise an easy shipboarding stop on the San Francisco waterfront. Walking around Aquatic Park and boarding historic ships are separate activities; follow on-site closure notices.
无车可以查 F Market & Wharves 在 The Embarcade: Without a car, check F Market & Wharves stops around The Embarcadero and Stockton. Your return stop may be on a different street or side. Drivers should budget for parking and read any discount conditions. PIER 39 offers self-service luggage lockers on Level 2 next to the California Welcome Center, with several sizes starting at $10 for all-day storage and unlimited access during that day. This paid service is separate from free public-area admission; confirm locker size, availability and current charges before use. Ordinary pets are not allowed; service animals are permitted.
穿防风外层，准备水；不要把海滨晴天当作一定暖和。: Bring a wind layer and water; sunshine does not guarantee a warm waterfront.
在公共观景处观察海狮，不投喂、不靠近浮台、不模仿叫声逗弄。: Watch sea lions from public viewing areas; do not feed them, approach their floats or provoke them.
给儿童约好走散后的集合点，拍照时把栏杆和人流放在注意范围。: Agree on a meeting point with children and stay aware of railings and crowds while photographing.
先核对一个最想去的付费项目，其他当作可取消的备选。: Check the one paid attraction you most want to visit and treat the rest as optional.
